title: Z/W mass ratio = 2/sqrt(3)

gate.PASS: model 2/sqrt(3)=1.1547, within +1.77% of PDG, residual RG-shaped
gate.FALSIFIED: ratio drifts off 2/sqrt(3) beyond what running can explain
gate.residual_note: F115/CM2b: measured SM trajectory passes through sin2_theta_W=1/4 and m_Z/m_W=2/sqrt(3) at mu_*~3.7 TeV; the +1.77% gap is a low-scale (few-TeV) matching offset, not a Planck desert-running effect. Falsifier criterion #2 (residual NOT RG-shaped) is therefore not triggered.

method: Closed-form symbolic (sympy exact Rational/sqrt); PDG comparison only float step.
